Serving a request
Employees (browser) → Web front end: load the app through the CDN (HTTPS)
Web front end → HTTPS load balancer: forward API calls
HTTPS load balancer → Chat API (streaming): run the business logic
Chat API (streaming) → Agent runtime (LangGraph): hand the request to the agent
Chat API (streaming) → Single sign-on: verify the user's sign-in token
Agent runtime (LangGraph) → LLM gateway (LiteLLM): send the prompt through the gateway
Agent runtime (LangGraph) → Knowledge index: retrieve relevant passages
Agent runtime (LangGraph) → Tool functions: call tools that look up or change data
Agent runtime (LangGraph) → Agent state + history: save the agent's progress and the conversation
Agent runtime (LangGraph) → Model and tool credentials: fetch credentials
Agent runtime (LangGraph) → AI guardrails: screen the prompt and the answer
LLM gateway (LiteLLM) → Models + embeddings: call the chosen model, falling back to another if it fails
Every model call → LLM tracing (Langfuse): record the prompt, tool calls, tokens and cost
Every component → Logs, metrics, alarms: send logs and metrics
